subject.title: feat: persist Manage stock on the Products Save

question: Should a clerk's disable be refused while a managed-SKU registration is in flight, or should the registration protocol gain coordinated cancellation before provider contact?
rationale: The required no-Inventory-on-disable invariant cannot be guaranteed by the current compare-and-set alone once an external provider call is in flight.

options.title: Refuse disable while registration is pending
options.body: Preserve the current provider protocol by returning a retryable conflict until Configure Inventory reaches a terminal state.

options.title: Add coordinated cancellation
options.body: Extend the registration protocol so disabling can cancel or fence the external operation before the provider is contacted.

recommendation.title: Refuse disable while registration is pending
recommendation.body: Preserve the current provider protocol by returning a retryable conflict until Configure Inventory reaches a terminal state.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available contributor with direct history on both Manage stock persistence iterations.
